 Entertainment
 Top Entertainment stories of the week: Christy Chung marks 10yrs of marriage; Priscilla Wong brings son to M'sia; Tony Leung Ka Fai, 68, still going strong
 By THE ENTERTAINMENT TEAM 
 Sunday, 15 Nov 2026
 | 10:10 PM MYT
 share 
 bookmark 
 Photos: Christy Chung/Instagram, Priscilla Wong/Instagram, China Daily/Asia News Network 
 Top Entertainment stories of the week (Nov 9 – Nov 15)
 1.  Celeb couple Christy Chung & Shawn Zhang mark 10th anniversary with romantic seaside ceremony 
 2.  Priscilla Wong takes son to Malaysia for work while husband Edwin Siu stays in Hong Kong 
 3.  Tony Leung Ka Fai, 68, says he's capable of taking care of himself despite age 
 4.  HK singer Alan Tam, 76, defies age, climbs all 999 steps of China's 'Stairway to Heaven' 
 5.  Casino heir Mario Ho wins praise for humility while travelling solo on public transport 
 6.  TVB star Mat Yeung seen taking orders, managing his own restaurant in Sunway
